summary.result: Additional investigation considering receiving soil characteristics based on the results of this study would help effective application of RSA to soil.
summary.background: In this study physical and chemical characteristics of rice straw ash (RSA) were analyzed in agricultural by-products such as the characteristics of soil pH, electric conductivity (EC), total phosphorus (T-P), available phosphate (Avail-P), and cation exchange capacity (CEC).
summary.method: TCLP and KSLT test results implied that the heavy metal concentrations were below the environmental standards and would not impose the risks.
